newsitem.title: JAPAN: Deutsche Telekom to list on TSE in Nov--paper.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche Telekom to list on TSE in Nov--paper.

text.p: Deutsche Telekom AG will list its shares on the foreign section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on November 19 to raise a little over 100 billion yen from the Japanese market, a newspaper said on Friday.

The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the German telecommunications giant was also planning to list its shares on the Frankfurt and New York markets to raise a total of one trillion yen from stock markets around the world.
Officials of the Tokyo Stock Exchange were not immediately available for comment on the report.
Deutsche Telekom said earlier this week in Germany that it would provide a detailed plan of its share launch in Frankfurt and New York at a news conference on Friday at 0900 GMT.
